title: Trust and Safety for AI Product Content | AIVideosUGC
description: AI content trust and safety at AIVideosUGC: what you can make, what we decline, how your uploads stay private and how to report a problem with a result.
h1: Trust and Safety for AI Product Content
lead: Trust and safety for AI content starts with who it's for: AIVideosUGC is built for stores making content about their own products. Here is what that means for your uploads, your results and the people who see them.
card: What you can make, how uploads stay private and how to report a problem.

paras: AIVideosUGC helps online stores turn their own product photos into short video ads and store-ready images. Use it for products you sell or are allowed to promote, on your store, marketplaces and social channels.

Requests that involve celebrities or public figures, brand logos or trademarks you don't own, or large amounts of text may be declined. We also don't allow content that impersonates real people, misleads buyers, sexualizes anyone, targets minors or promotes harm.
Your uploads and results stay in your account and are not shown publicly. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use, and check every result against your real product before you publish it.

Show what your product really does. Add prices, dates and claims yourself in your design or ad tool so they are exactly right, and follow each platform's rules, including any rules about labeling AI-generated content.

If you see content made with AIVideosUGC that breaks these rules, or you think your rights have been affected, email support@aivideosugc.com with the details. We aim to reply within two business days.

faq.q: Can I download the product assets made in my account?
faq.a: Yes. Download the photos and videos from your signed-in account; review source-photo rights and each platform’s rules before publishing.

faq.q: Are my uploads used to show other customers?
faq.a: No. Your uploads and results stay in your account and are not shown publicly.

faq.q: Can other customers see my uploaded product photos?
faq.a: No. Uploaded photos and generated results stay in your account and are not displayed in a public gallery.

faq.q: Where should I check content and data-use rules?
faq.a: Use the current Privacy, Terms, Content, and Refunds pages for policy details; this FAQ only states account-scoped storage and failed-job credit returns.
